messages:
maya: Heads up — we need a safe operator flow for the priority telemetry backfill after yesterday's late-ingest spike. Thinking a lightweight 'preview' API that shows quota & routing impact before you hit Start. cc @sasha @ben
ben: Agreed. Current console estimate is too vague (rows only). We need slot-seconds + burst-quota delta. Otherwise ops will keep getting surprised.
sasha: Can we reuse replay-sim? It already returns cost-ish numbers. But replay-sim is heavy and touches S3.
maya: That's the debate. Replay-sim is accurate but slow/side-effecty. Proposal: new POST /backfills/preview that samples and consults routing policies + quota model to return estimates fast.
ops-bot: DEPLOY: backfill-service v2 -> canary (eu-prod) :rocket:
jkline: I'm in favor of a new endpoint. replay-sim has hidden I/O (temp reads) and sometimes trips throttles. Preview should be read-only, sample-based, and fast.
ben: Console UX suggestion: show two numbers side-by-side — est slot-seconds and est burst-quota impact (30m window). Also a routing breakdown (which pool/region/model variant will be used). Add a toggle "simulate fallbacks".
sasha: Also need permission gating + audit log for previews. Enterprise/private customers will ask for KMS/audit hooks.
maya: Minimal API sketch: POST /backfills/preview { "query": "...", "window": {"start":"2026-03-19T00:00Z","end":"2026-03-19T23:59Z"}, "sampling_pct": 1 } -> { "est_rows": 12345, "est_slot_seconds": 5400, "burst_quota_30m": 2, "routing_breakdown": ["pool-a: 70%","pool-b: 30%"], "notes": "sampling-based, CI +/- 10%" }
ben: Routing breakdown should include fallback variants and cost delta if fallback quantized models are used. That helps teams decide to schedule during low-usage windows.
sasha: Add a preemptible-flag simulation so we can surface likely preemptions and how much extra time that would add. Also return confidence intervals.
maya: Example request/response in the console would be:
```
POST /backfills/preview
{
  "query": { "metric": "agg_hours", "filters": {"region":"eu"} },
  "time_range": ["2026-03-18","2026-03-19"],
  "sampling_pct": 0.5,
  "simulate_fallbacks": true
}

200 OK
{
  "est_rows": 11_200,
  "est_slot_seconds": 3_600,
  "burst_quota_30m": 1,
  "routing_breakdown": [{"pool":"gpu-eu-1","pct":82},{"pool":"gpu-eu-spot","pct":18}],
  "ci_pct": 9
}
```
jkline: UI notes: Add a Preview button next to Start Backfill. Open modal with the numbers, routing map, and a checkbox "Recompute dashboard freshness" that explains downstream impact. Also a link "Open full simulation" that runs replay-sim for thoroughness.
ops-bot: INCIDENT-BOT: Reminder — yesterday's ad-hoc backfill spiked quota and caused ~5m degraded /telemetry/ingest latency. Runbook updated: backfill_preflight_required = true.
ben: Action items: maya to prototype API + sample logic; jkline to mock console modal; I'll audit quota calc libs for sampling support. Target: prototype PR by EOD Friday.
sasha: For sampling, we should include CI +/- and call out known blindspots (prefix-cache hits, KV cache reuse). Rough CI target: 10%.
maya: I'll wire a small PoC that uses existing metrics index to sample keys and apply routing policy heuristics. Will ping here with PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
